name: Dark Onirisme
source:
Do you want to make your life your greatest dream?

"The 'ONIRISME 3000' is about to be available to everyone. This science piece of work is going to let you leave your sad reality and join your most beautiful dreams... or your darkest fantasies. However, the 'ONIRISME 3000' just needs to go through some tests before being sold. Be patient, it's just for tomorrow!"

Three children wake up in a strange place where everything is just nonsense. They don't remember why they're here but they know that they have to find a way out. Indeed, many dangers are lurking in the darkness.

[Edited from [url=https://overtired-fox.itch.io/darkonirisme]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你想让你的生活成为你最大的梦想吗？

“‘ONIRISME 3000’即将向所有人开放。这项科学作品将让你离开悲伤的现实，加入你最美丽的梦想……或者你最黑暗的幻想。然而，‘ONIRISME 3000’只需要在出售前经过一些测试。耐心点，它只是为了明天！”

三个孩子在一个陌生的地方醒来，那里的一切都毫无意义。他们不记得自己为什么在这里，但他们知道必须找到出路。确实，黑暗中潜伏着许多危险。

[编辑自[url=https://overtired-fox.itch.io/darkonirisme]Itch.io[/url]]
